scope: Host report lifecycle fault injection and native baselines on Linux; no LLVM plugin execution

after_fix.KeyboardInterrupt: Current UUID, RUNNING, vmp_verified=false; interruption propagates
after_fix.SystemExit: Current UUID, RUNNING, vmp_verified=false; termination propagates

fault_method: Seed report.json with old HOST_VMP_PASS; import actual host runner; replace subprocess.run with each injected exception at the first GF2 source verification command; invoke execute and assert report status, false verification and replacement run UUID. No compiler or plugin success is mocked.
limitations: Previously recorded macOS VM passes remain historical evidence; they were not rerun here
No iPhone signing or execution was performed
No production VMP policy or protection boundary changed
No deleted unit test suite was restored
